subject: Post-call: deployment choice and Private VPC network ownership
body:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finsecure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: deployment choice and Private VPC network ownership

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps on deployment mode and networking ownership so we keep momentum:

Key notes from call:
- FinSecure primary objective: production-grade inference with strict data residency and private connectivity.
- Preferred path: Private VPC (Redwood Private) unless short-term throughput needs push to Dedicated as bridge. Hosted ruled out for regulated workloads.
- Network asks we discussed: PrivateLink vs VPC Peering, egress IP allowlist, TLS termination point, and whether FinSecure will run NAT/proxy for outbound requests.

Open questions (need answers from your netops):
1) PrivateLink vs Peering: do you require interface endpoints (PrivateLink) for strict tenant isolation, or will a peering arrangement that uses route-based access be acceptable?
2) Egress IPs: will FinSecure provide a static set of outbound IPs to allowlist, or do you need Redwood to provide advertised egress IPs from our side?
3) TLS termination: do you want Redwood to terminate TLS at our endpoint (mTLS option) or pass TLS through to your LB?
4) KMS / key control: any restrictions on customer-managed keys for logs/metrics? (we support KMS integrations but need to confirm scope)

Proposed next steps:
- Samir/Elena: confirm which connectivity model you prefer (PrivateLink or Peering) and share a point of contact from NetOps.
- NetOps: we will follow with a short Network Requirements PDF that lists ports, CIDR ranges, and example PrivateLink VPC endpoint policies.
- Internal: Ben / Karthik to scope engineering checklist for tenant isolation and egress model.

I'll attach the first-pass network requirements doc after you confirm the NetOps contact.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finsecure.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@finsecure.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: deployment choice and Private VPC network ownership

Thanks Ava — quick clarifications from NetOps side:
- Our preference is PrivateLink. We need interface endpoints to avoid routing tenant traffic through peering routes for compliance reasons.
- Egress: we manage outbound NAT and can provide a stable set of egress IPs for allowlisting.
- TLS: we prefer Redwood to terminate TLS at the PrivateLink endpoint with mutual TLS to authenticate service -> client for internal telemetry ingestion.
- KMS: we will want to use our KMS for at-rest encryption of application logs retained in our environment; logs forwarded to Redwood must be scoped to exclude raw request payloads.

NetOps POC: Elena Gomez (elena.gomez@finsecure.com). She can take the network requirements doc and map it against our internal firewall rules.

Samir
VP, Infrastructure
FinSecure

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: deployment choice and Private VPC network ownership

Ava / Karthik —

Good, PrivateLink preference simplifies the topology. Quick notes for scoping:
- Engineering will need the exact list of FinSecure egress IPs and the VPC CIDRs for endpoint permissions.
- We should prepare a template VPC Endpoint Policy that limits access to the FinSecure principal and service.
- Quantization/throughput: if they plan to use Dedicated temporarily for burst, we need expected RPS and peak tokens per minute to size GPU pool. Ask Sales to capture expected QPS/peak tokens.

I'll draft the endpoint policy template and a short sizing note. Karthik, can you confirm if we support mTLS termination at PrivateLink endpoints today or if that requires a follow-up ops task?

Ben
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finsecure.com>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@finsecure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: deployment choice and Private VPC network ownership

Samir / Elena —

Thanks for the quick clarifications — good to have Elena as NetOps POC. Attached is the first-pass network requirements PDF (finsecure_network_requirements_v1.pdf) with:
- Required ports and directions (TCP/443, TCP/10250 for kube health, etc.)
- Example PrivateLink endpoint policy that limits access to FinSecure account principals
- Placeholders for egress IPs and VPC CIDRs (please fill and return)
- Short checklist for TLS/mTLS options and KMS notes

Concrete next steps and owners:
- Elena: complete the egress IP list and VPC CIDR block and reply to this thread (owner: FinSecure NetOps).
- Karthik: we need engineering confirmation on mTLS termination at the PrivateLink endpoint and any additional config for KV cache isolation (owner: Redwood infra).
- Ben: prepare a brief sizing worksheet for Dedicated bridging capacity in case they want burst capacity before Private deployment is fully provisioned (owner: Customer Solutions).
- I will schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk through the PDF once Elena fills in the blanks. Proposed window: Wed 14 Oct 2026 09:00-11:00 PT — please confirm availability.

If there are any policy/legal constraints around KMS/logs, Samir, please flag and we can loop in Security.

Thanks — attaching the doc now.

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: finsecure_network_requirements_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 118KB)
